subject: Demo recap & proposed evaluation playbook — HavenCare POC
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Green <laura.green@havencare.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@havencare.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: Demo recap & proposed evaluation playbook — HavenCare POC

Hi Laura / Tom —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our demo + the proposed evaluation playbook for the pilot we discussed.

Key capabilities we showed:
- Real-time document ingestion and redaction hooks
- Cost/latency controls per route and per-model
- Built-in evals and regression alerts tied to prompt sets

Proposed POC objectives (please confirm):
1) Accuracy: >85% intent match on the triage set (n=500)
2) Latency: p95 generation <450ms for 512-token batches
3) Cost: target average cost/token below the threshold we discussed

Draft timeline (6-week pilot):
- Week 0: kickoff & environment access
- Week 1–2: integration + sample ingestion
- Week 3–4: functional validation & metrics collection
- Week 5: quality review & threshold evaluation
- Week 6: decision and next steps

Owners we recommend:
- Redwood AE / integration lead: Aditya Rao
- Redwood CS / trial manager: Neha Kapoor
- HavenCare engineering lead: TBD (please confirm)

I've attached a short POC scope and an evaluation checklist for your team to review (havencare-poc-scope-v1.pdf, redwood-eval-checklist.xlsx). Also included a mutual action plan template.

Can you confirm the success criteria above and the preferred kickoff week? If the timeline looks tight for you, we can compress the validation phase to 3 weeks and extend the collection window afterwards.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Attachment: havencare-poc-scope-v1.pdf
From: Laura Green <laura.green@havencare.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@havencare.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 17:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo recap & proposed evaluation playbook — HavenCare POC

Aditya —

Appreciate the clear recap. High level we are aligned; a few clarifications from our side:

Success metrics
- Accuracy: we'll validate intent match on two cohorts — triage (n=500) and escalation (n=200). Target is 85% on triage and 78% on escalation.
- Latency: can we get p95 for both 128-token and 512-token profiles? 450ms target is fine for 512.

Security & data
- We need a short summary of how Redwood will handle PHI and any PII during evaluation. We can't provide live PHI; we'll supply a de-identified sample and a small subset of realistic (masked) records.
- Procurement would like to see a SOC2/ISO reference and a short list of the controls applied to Hosted API during a pilot.

Timeline
- Dec 13 kickoff looks good for us. Could you schedule a 30–45 minute kickoff with engineering and CS on your side?

Procurement contact: procurement@havencare.com

I'll loop in Tom for engineering timelines.

Best,
Laura
VP Product, HavenCare
Attachment: security-questions.pdf

Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo recap & proposed evaluation playbook — HavenCare POC

Laura — thanks, noted and glad we're aligned. Quick responses and updated plan below.

Security & data handling
- For the pilot we recommend: use of de-identified samples + Redwood-managed masking guidance. We will provide a short template for masking and an ingestion script. Any live PHI should not be uploaded to hosted endpoints — if needed we can run the pilot in a Private VPC configuration (we can scope that in parallel).
- SOC 2: Redwood Inference is SOC 2 Type II compliant; I'll send the compliance pack via secure link once procurement confirms an NDA. Controls summary: access logging, KMS-backed key management, retention policy controls, role-based access.

Latency profiles
- We'll capture p95 for both 128-token and 512-token profiles. Our runtime will report per-route token breakdowns so you'll see both numbers.

Updated owners & kickoff
- Redwood: Aditya (AE / integration owner), Neha (CS / trial manager), Marissa (Solutions Engineer)
- HavenCare: Laura (product), Tom (engineering), Procurement (procurement@havencare.com)

Concrete kickoff options (all PST):
- Mon, Dec 13 — 10:00–10:45 (preferred)
- Tue, Dec 14 — 14:00–14:45

Attachments: I've uploaded an updated POC scope and the mutual action plan (mutual-action-plan.docx). Also included a short checklist for the security questions (redwood-eval-checklist.xlsx).

Next steps for you: confirm which kickoff slot works and the name of the HavenCare engineering lead who will own integrations.

Thanks,
Aditya
